name: farnell-plugins
description: Matt Farnell's personal Claude Code tools: adversarial-review (Claude × Codex code review) and ralph (the PR pipeline grinder).

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial Claude + Codex code review of a markdown file or GitHub PR — blind parallel first pass, up to N debate rounds, machine-verified citations, and a fresh-context refuter pass over every agreed finding. Resumable from disk.

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Ralph PR pipeline: grind a feature/roadmap doc into merged PRs, one per task — red tests, implement, check, Opus review, scripted merge — each stage a fresh agent in its own worktree, all state on GitHub so any session resumes. One core; each repo adds a small adapter (.claude/ralph.json).
